page.overview:
Who is Amazoness Queen?

Amazoness Queen is a character version of the card, "Amazoness Queen". She appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus as a Single Duel opponent.

You can unlock this opponent during Story Mode (clear chapter 3).

In Over the Nexus, Amazoness Queen uses a Deck titled "Amazoness Law".
